result.question: How much cash and cash equivalents did Apple report at the end of fiscal 2025?
result.answer: Apple reported cash and cash equivalents of $35,934 million (approximately $35.9 billion) at the end of fiscal 2025, which concluded on September 27, 2025. This figure is confirmed by the XBRL fact for CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue as of 2025-09-27 [xbrl:0000320193-25-000079:us-gaap:CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue:2025-09-27], the September 27, 2025 column of the condensed consolidated balance sheet in Apple's Q1 2026 10-Q [0000320193-26-000006:part-i--item-1-p002], and the ending balance on the consolidated statements of cash flows in Apple's 2025 Form 10-K [0000320193-25-000079:item-8-p004].
